profile.summary: A general engineering contractor based in Oakland, California, doing business as Emergency Rooter Construction (formerly ER Plumbing & Construction). It does plumbing, sewer lateral and underground utility work, site improvements and sewer lateral inspection and certification for customers across the San Francisco Bay Area. It also does construction work in occupied buildings such as schools.
